title: Modular and Mobile Capacity Planning for Hyperconnected Supply Chain Networks
summary: The increased volatility of markets and the pressing need for resource sustainability are driving supply chains towards more agile, distributed, and dynamic designs. Motivated by the Physical Internet initiative, we introduce the Dynamic Stochastic Modular and Mobile Capacity Planning (DSMMCP) problem, which fosters hyperconnectivity through a network-of-networks architecture with modular and mobile capacities.
